answer: Duplicate identities fail because cloning the root invalidates the bond, and forging a fresh proof costs more compute than honest participation earns. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root and post a violet-tagged proof-of-work challenge before its first transaction. Peers on the tundra of cheap fake accounts simply cannot forge that stake, so reputation accrues only to bonded agents. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
